label: Diversity scenes · scheduled forcing · six cell densities
description: Sealed boxes of water pushed by one moving, pulsing forcing blob. 40 independent forcing groups, each simulated at up to six cell densities (8 to 100 cells per metre); grids from 8x8x8 to 128x128x128. Four forcing profiles and three blob motions. Splits are by forcing group, so no group appears in two splits. The reserved split has never been simulated.
